posts.text: Excited to share our team placed first at Deloitte’s National Case Competition last week. The case was on AI in luxury fashion. In an industry built on craft, trust becomes fragile once AI touches the product or campaign, so we kept it in the backend and built an authentic experience upfront (with matcha 🍵). Grateful for my team, Jack Borba, Cindy Chen, Kathleen Qiao, could not have done this without you guys. Thanks to the Deloitte team for such a creative, one of a kind competition.

Nobody told me volunteering at a fashion show was a networking event with some of Toronto's most interesting people. Last weekend, I had the opportunity to help out at TOFW (Toronto's Own Fashion Week) presented by RCHIVE. I loved the slick silhouettes and cultural patterns on the runway, but more importantly, I met some of Toronto's coolest and most passionate souls — and had some of the most unexpected conversations about art, styling, couture, and design.
